priceAdjust.label: Price adjust on orders
priceAdjust.help: Staff may take money off an open order before it is booked: a taka amount, a percent, the customer's wallet or the delivery charge, with a reason. Every adjustment is a new line in the order's price ledger. On as shipped (the owner's decision, 13 Nov 2026). Add a role under 'Limits per role' to say how much it may take off by itself; a role that is not listed needs approval for everything. Above the limit the owner approves with the PIN.

mergeOrders.label: Merge orders
mergeOrders.help: Fold one open order of a customer into another, from the Merge button on the order list. Off until you switch it on. Look-back days: how many days before the kept order the other one may have been placed (5 as shipped). Auto-merge: do it by itself when an order lands, only when the addresses match (off). Different address: ask a person to confirm the kept order's address, or refuse. An order that is Packed or with the courier is never merged.

replacement.label: Replacement for a defective or wrong item
replacement.help: Send a defective, damaged or wrong piece again free: the same piece, no price difference, no refund and no wallet credit, and the old piece comes back. On as shipped (the owner's decision, 13 Nov 2026). Hours: how long after delivery one can be opened (168 as shipped). Old piece days: how many days the old piece has to come back (7 as shipped; shown on the returns board, never billed by itself). Reasons: which of defect, damage and wrong open one.
